original_test_intent: Verify front USB3 slot 1 sustains 12-hour USB stress at 0C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails without data, link, controller or platform errors.
original_method: Map connector to hub/controller and qualified USB3 tool/cable; preserve baseline; control humidity/dew point, cold-soak and ramp to measured -5% rails; verify SuperSpeed negotiation and run approved SST integrity profile for 12 hours while recording link speed, transfers, resets/retries and platform events; abort on limits, warm safely and restore nominal state before disconnecting.
manual_activity: Operator installs tool, controls dry chamber/negative rails, supervises stress and warms/restores safely.
required_inputs: Abort, warm-up, disconnect and restoration procedure
safety_requirements: Use calibrated rail measurement and prevent undershoot
Abort on moisture, controller-reset storm, data mismatch, electrical or thermal fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening or cable work
agent_execution_scope: Must not manipulate connector, chamber or rails and must not decide verdict
